description: Accueil vélo en Loire-Atlantique is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Loire-Atlantique Développement. List of establishments awarded the “Accueil vélo” label in Loire-Atlantique. This national label allows bicycle tourists to identify establishments and places suitable for cycling tourism, thus benefiting from appropriate reception and services. This dataset will be updated in early 2013. Coverage: Loire-Atlantique Développement. The portal shows the English title as "Welcome bike in Loire-Atlantique" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Loire-Atlantique Développement. Its keywords include discipline-sportive, certification, vtt, tourisme. The listing shows 4 download or service links in JSON, CSV, XML, XLS. The listing shows 2016-01-14 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (http://opendatacommons.org/licenses/odbl/summary/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
